question: When did Cyberpunk 2077's positive review share change the most?
key_points: Biggest shift around Apr 2022: positive share ~68% before vs ~89% after
Overall trend up (~+7 points/year, significant)
answer: The positive review share for Cyberpunk 2077 changed the most around November 2023, with a significant shift from 84.63% before November to 94.02% after November (p < 0.001) [T1].

question: Did Palworld's Sakurajima update change how players review the game?
key_points: No meaningful change: 94.0% before vs 93.4% after (p~0.41)
Review volume after the update is much lower (1.3k vs 16.4k); the sentiment sample after is small (56)
answer:
- The Sakurajima update was released on 2024-06-27.
- Review trend analysis shows no significant change in the positive review share before and after the update (94% before vs. 93.44% after, p-value = 0.41, not statistically significant) [T1].
- Sentiment analysis comparing reviews before and after the update also shows no significant change in overall sentiment or specific aspects like gameplay, story, performance, bugs, and price (all p-values > 0.05) [T2].
- Therefore, the Sakurajima update did not significantly change how players review the game.

question: What did Cities: Skylines II patch 1.1.0f1 include?
key_points: The Editor and mod support (Modding Wavelet), plus performance improvements and bug fixes
Released alongside paid content: Beach Properties asset pack and Deluxe Relax Station
answer:
Cities: Skylines II patch 1.1.0f1, released on 2024-03-25, included the following:

- **Paid Content**: Beach Properties and Deluxe Relax Radio Station.
- **Editor and Modding Support**: Added code modding support, modding toolchain installation status, and an Editor with features like map creation, import/export height map, resource map, climate selection, and water source addition.
- **Performance Improvements**: Optimized various systems, reduced frame-time spikes, improved UI rendering, and reduced overhead of rendering curves in UI.
- **General Fixes & Improvements**: Addressed several bugs and issues related to building upgrades, transportation lines, milestones, and more.

Source: [1]

question: Did Palworld's Sakurajima update change how players review the game?
key_points: No meaningful change: 94.0% before vs 93.4% after (p~0.41)
Review volume after the update is much lower (1.3k vs 16.4k); the sentiment sample after is small (56)
answer:
- The Sakurajima update was released on 2024-06-27 [3].
- Before the update (from 2024-01-01 to 2024-06-01), there were 16,384 reviews, with 94% positive [T1].
- After the update (from 2024-07-01 to 2024-11-01), there were 1,326 reviews, with 93.44% positive [T1].
- The difference in positive review share is -0.56%, with p = 0.41, which is not statistically significant [T1].

Conclusion: The Sakurajima update did not significantly change how players review the game.

question: What did Cities: Skylines II patch 1.1.0f1 include?
key_points: The Editor and mod support (Modding Wavelet), plus performance improvements and bug fixes
Released alongside paid content: Beach Properties asset pack and Deluxe Relax Station
answer:
Cities: Skylines II patch 1.1.0f1 included several updates and fixes:

- **Paid Content**: Added new North American and European Waterfront Zoning with 30 new buildings, 24 additional variants, 4 new palm trees, 6 new signature buildings, and a Deluxe Relax Radio Station with 16 new songs and new DJ content.

- **Editor & Modding**: Introduced code modding support, modding toolchain installation, and an editor for map creation, including import/export of height maps, resource maps, and defining map details.

- **Performance Improvements**: Optimized various systems to reduce frame-time spikes and overall simulation performance, improved frametime while placing buildings, and optimized UI rendering.

- **General Fixes**: Addressed numerous bugs and issues, including crashes, incorrect notifications, and performance stutters, as detailed in the patch notes [1], [2], [4], [5], [6].

question: How does Balatro's Plasma Deck change scoring, and how do you unlock it?
key_points: Plasma Deck balances (averages) Chips and Mult before multiplying, and doubles base Blind size
Unlocked by winning a run on Blue Stake difficulty or harder
answer:
- The Plasma Deck changes scoring by balancing the total number of Chips and Mult before multiplying them to calculate the hand score. For example, a hand with 78 Chips and 4 Mult would be calculated as (78 + 4) / 2 = 41, then 41 × 41 = 1,681.
- To unlock the Plasma Deck, you must win a run on the Blue Stake difficulty or harder [3].

This deck also doubles the size of Blinds, offsetting the higher hand scores [1].

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Plasma Deck
documents.text:
number: 14
title: Plasma Deck
limit: Balance blue Chips and red Mult when calculating score for played hand red X2 base Blind size
unlock: Win a run with any deck on the Blue Stake difficulty or harder

The Plasma Deck is one of the decks you can unlock when playing the game, by winning a run on the Blue Stake difficulty. This deck changes how a hand score is calculated and doubles the size of Blinds.

For example if you had a Level 1 flush (Q, 10, 9, 7, 6), the hand score would normally be

77 × 4 = 308

However with the Plasma deck, the total Chips and total Mult are averaged together (or balanced) before they get multiplied.

78 + 4 = 82
82 / 2 = 41
41 × 41 = 1,681

This is a significantly higher number and is offset by having Blind sizes twice as high when playing this deck. In fact, the hand score will always be higher after balancing (except in the case that its Chips and Mult are equal). The hand score is calculated as .

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Plasma Deck > Synergies
documents.text:
1.5x Polychrome × 8 Mult = 12 Mult— the Polychrome effectively gives +4 Mult which balances to +2 Chips and +2 Mult
1.5x Polychrome × 8,000 Mult = 12,000 Mult—the Polychrome effectively gives +4,000 Mult which balances to +2,000 Chips and +2,000 Mult

This makes the Plasma Deck one of the best decks for Endless mode, since even though the score requirement per Ante is doubled, by focusing on the XMult, the score one achieves is almost squared from the score achieved in any other deck.

An Endless run example: 4 Polychrome Red Seal Glass 2s, Level 20 Four of a Kind, The Idol/Blueprint/Hack/Brainstorm/Perkeo, and Observatory with 115 Negative Mars cards

Chips:
Each card gives 2 Chips × 4 triggers (one from card, one from Red Seal, one from Blueprint Hack, one from Hack) = 8 Chips
The resulting Chips is 630 (base) + (8 Chips × 4 cards) = 630 + 32 = 662 Chips
Mult:
Each card gives an XMult of (2 Glass × 1.5 Polychrome × 2 Idol × 2 Brainstorm Idol)^4 retriggers = 12^4 = 20,736
The resulting Mult is 64 (base) × (20,736^4 cards) × (1.5^115 Mars cards) = 64 × 184,884,258,895,036,416 × 178,030,655,708,718,648,266 = 2.1e39 Mult

On a regular deck, the resulting score is 662 Chips × 2.1e39 Mult = 1.4e42, which is enough to beat Ante 19.

But on the Plasma Deck, the resulting score is ((662 Chips + 2.1e39 Mult) / 2)2 = (1.1e39)2 = 1.1e78, which is enough to beat Ante 24.

This means, on the Plasma Deck, this build with the current setup has a headstart of 5 Antes.

documents.text:
Balatro has 8 stakes, which add progressively ramping difficulty modifiers to each game. To unlock a stake for a deck, you must complete a run using the highest currently unlocked stake. Progression through the different stakes is unique to each starting deck, meaning that you must unlock each stake individually for each deck.

The 8 stakes, listed in the order that they are unlocked. Note that each stake applies the modifiers of all previous stakes.

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Plasma Deck > Synergies
documents.text:
You want to aim for the highest raw number boosts to Chips and Mult. Since Chips start off at a higher number, most Jokers and Consumables boost Chips with a larger raw number than Mult (e.g. Bonus Card's +30 Chips vs Mult Card's +4 Mult). This is roughly balanced on other decks, but on the Plasma Deck, Chips and Mult equally contribute to the hand score, so using cards with large +Chips will result in a much higher score.

2,4,6,8,10 with Even Steven = 10 Chips and 10 Mult
A,3,5,7,9 with Odd Todd = 77 Chips and 77 Mult

In a normal deck, focusing on only leads to a non-optimal distribution, which is fixed with the Plasma Deck and can result in much higher final scores with identical builds and the same hand.

Normal Deck Scoring: 100 × 10,000 = 1,000,000
Plasma Deck Scoring: 5,050 × 5,050 = 25,502,500

Chip boosters:

any Jokers that add large +Chips
Bonus Card enhancement (+30 Chips)
Foil edition (+50 Chips)
Red seal will trigger the card twice, so you get twice the Chips
higher rank cards (Ace card's +11 Chips vs Two card's +2 Chips)

However in later Antes, Chips only carry so far since they can only be additive in the base game (i.e. there are no XChips jokers in the base game). On the other hand, Mult can be multiplicative. While XMult is slow early on, with a high enough base Mult, this boost can be much greater than +Chips in the late game. In this example, one would need +4,000 Chips to match the power of adding a Polychrome:

question: Did Palworld's Sakurajima update change how players review the game?
key_points: No meaningful change: 94.0% before vs 93.4% after (p~0.41)
Review volume after the update is much lower (1.3k vs 16.4k); the sentiment sample after is small (56)
answer:
- The Sakurajima update was released on 2024-06-27.
- Before the update (from January to June 2024), 16,384 reviews were analyzed, with 94% positive reviews [T1].
- After the update (from July to November 2024), 1,326 reviews were analyzed, with 93.44% positive reviews [T1].
- The difference in positive review share before and after the update is -0.0056, with a p-value of 0.41, indicating the difference is not statistically significant [T1].

No significant change in how players review Palworld was observed after the Sakurajima update.

documents.text:
Hello, everyone!

The release of Palworld's first major update, the Sakurajima Update, has been scheduled for Thursday, June 27, 2024.

In addition to the release date, the latest trailer has been released.

[previewyoutube=fKzLdPZr2Fk;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition to the new island of Sakurajima, the update is full of new content and mechanics! So much so that we couldn't fit them all in the trailer!

We hope you are looking forward to it!

Palworld Development Team

documents.label: Palworld · patch_note · 2024-06-27 · Major update! Sakurajima v0.3.1.: New area, Pals, buildings and more!
documents.text:
・New Passive Skills
⤷ Philanthropist - Greatly reduces the time required to produce eggs
⤷ Impatient - Reduced cooldown on active skills
⤷ Infinite Stamina - Increased stamina (Only on mountable Pals)
⤷ Noble - Pals with this passive will give you an advantage when trading with merchants
⤷ Nocturnal - Pals with this passive become nocturnal and will work throughout the night

▼Multiplayer
・Added a new setting that always rejects guild invites

▼Balance Adjustment
・Due to the increase in accessory slots, accessories with the same name have been changed so they cannot be equipped more than once
・Defensive accessories have been balanced due to the increase in accessory slots.
・Due to the addition of many new Pals, some Pal breeding combinations have been changed
・Adjusted the selling price of all Pals. The selling price of Alpha Pals is now about twice that of the original species

▼Bug Fixes
・Mitigations have been added for an issue that caused PCs to freeze when closing the game
・Changed the grappling gun behaviour to make it less likely to get stuck
・Many many many other minor bug fixes

▼Other
・A warning will now be displayed if the GPU driver is too out-of-date

▼Soundtrack
・6 new songs have been added to soundtrack. If you have already purchased the game, please update the soundtrack.
*Please note that the soundtrack update may be delayed by about a day.

＝＝＝

Thank you for your continued support of Palworld.

・The building system has been reworked and improved! Basic construction is now much more intuitive and smooth!

※Note: Too many Pals at one base may lead to performance issues

・It is now possible to permanently assign a Pal to a specific facility from the Monitoring Stand
・Cakes will now be transported to chests as a priority
・Readjusted the work priority order for Pals
・Changes to defense facility specifications. Work pals will use them automatically even if they are not assigned to a specific facility
・Measures and mitigation for base pals getting stuck when a route cannot be taken

question: How did players react to Total War: WARHAMMER III Patch 4.1?
key_points: Strongly positive reaction: positive share 40.7% before vs 75.7% after (p<0.001)
Bug and price complaints fell significantly (bugs ~23% -> ~5%, price ~35% -> ~16%)
answer:
- Players' sentiment towards Total War: WARHAMMER III improved significantly after Patch 4.1. Before the patch (August 2023 to November 2023), 38.53% of reviews were positive, while after the patch (December 2023 to February 2024), this increased to 61.01% (p-value = 0.0084), indicating a statistically significant improvement [T2].
- The patch notably reduced complaints about bugs, with the bug complaint share dropping from 19.8% before the patch to 2.57% after (p-value = 0.0056) [T2].
- Positive sentiment increased across the review period following the patch, with the positive share of reviews rising from 40.7% before November 2023 to 75.7% after (p-value = 0.000) [T1].

Greetings!

After 3 new Legendary faction leaders arrived in Total War: WARHAMMER III with Update 4.0 and Shadows of Change, we've been hard at work to bring out a steady stream of fixes and adjustments in the build-up to Patch 4.1.

But what comes with Patch 4.1, you ask? Well, let's not faff about, and dive right into the patch notes with some juicy highlights:

- Tear down those walls and bolster your own with the latest settlements and sieges battle update.
- Mix things up on the fly with skill point resets.

- Customize your main menu background with 19 additional themes.

question: How did players react to Total War: WARHAMMER III Patch 4.1?
key_points: Strongly positive reaction: positive share 40.7% before vs 75.7% after (p<0.001)
Bug and price complaints fell significantly (bugs ~23% -> ~5%, price ~35% -> ~16%)
answer:
- The positive review share increased from 40.7% before Patch 4.1 (May 2023 to November 2023) to 75.7% after Patch 4.1 (December 2023 to May 2024), with a statistically significant difference (p < 0.001) [T1].
- The positive review share also increased from 31.0% before the split date (October 2023 to November 2023) to 53.3% after the split date (November 2023 to December 2023), but this difference was not statistically significant (p = 0.146) [T2].
- Complaints about bugs decreased from 11.5% before Patch 4.1 to 0% after Patch 4.1, but the difference was not statistically significant (p = 0.146) [T2].
- No complaints were mentioned regarding performance, gameplay, story, or controls after Patch 4.1 [T2].
- The patch introduced new features such as settlement and siege battle updates, skill point resets, and bug fixes, which may have contributed to the positive reception [1].

question: How does Balatro's Plasma Deck change scoring, and how do you unlock it?
key_points: Plasma Deck balances (averages) Chips and Mult before multiplying, and doubles base Blind size
Unlocked by winning a run on Blue Stake difficulty or harder
answer:
- **Scoring Change**: The Plasma Deck changes the scoring calculation by squaring the average of the Chip and Mult scores, rather than multiplying them separately. For example, a hand with 78 Chips and 4 Mult would normally score 78 × 4 = 308, but with the Plasma Deck, it scores (78 + 4) / 2 = 41, then 41 × 41 = 1,681. This method always results in a higher score unless the Chip and Mult values are equal [2].

- **Unlock Method**: The Plasma Deck is unlocked by winning a run on the Blue Stake difficulty or higher [4].

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Guide: naneinf > Unseeded Naneinf without Legendary Jokers > Deck
documents.text: This method requires the Plasma since this Deck squares the average of your Chip and Mult scores, enabling higher scoring.

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Plasma Deck
documents.text:
number: 14
title: Plasma Deck
limit: Balance blue Chips and red Mult when calculating score for played hand red X2 base Blind size
unlock: Win a run with any deck on the Blue Stake difficulty or harder

The Plasma Deck is one of the decks you can unlock when playing the game, by winning a run on the Blue Stake difficulty. This deck changes how a hand score is calculated and doubles the size of Blinds.

For example if you had a Level 1 flush (Q, 10, 9, 7, 6), the hand score would normally be

77 × 4 = 308

However with the Plasma deck, the total Chips and total Mult are averaged together (or balanced) before they get multiplied.

78 + 4 = 82
82 / 2 = 41
41 × 41 = 1,681

This is a significantly higher number and is offset by having Blind sizes twice as high when playing this deck. In fact, the hand score will always be higher after balancing (except in the case that its Chips and Mult are equal). The hand score is calculated as .

documents.text:
Playing many scoring cards is very efficient in this deck, example Two Pair:

A,A,10,10 = 62 Chips and 2 Mult, which becomes 32 Chips and 32 Mult = 1,024

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Stakes
documents.text:
Balatro has 8 stakes, which add progressively ramping difficulty modifiers to each game. To unlock a stake for a deck, you must complete a run using the highest currently unlocked stake. Progression through the different stakes is unique to each starting deck, meaning that you must unlock each stake individually for each deck.

The 8 stakes, listed in the order that they are unlocked. Note that each stake applies the modifiers of all previous stakes.

StakeName EffectUnlocks Deck on win1White StakeBase difficulty None2Red StakeSmall Blind gives no reward moneyZodiac3Green StakeRequired score scales faster for each AntePainted4Black Stake 30% chance for Jokers in shops or booster packs to have an Eternal sticker (Can't be sold or destroyed)Anaglyph5Blue Stake -1 DiscardPlasma6Purple StakeRequired score scales even faster for each AnteNone7 Orange Stake30% chance for Jokers in shops or booster packs to have a Perishable sticker (Debuffed after 5 Rounds)Erratic8Gold Stake30% chance for Jokers in shops or booster packs to have a Rental sticker (Costs $3 per round, can be bought for $1)
The first Soul card in a Gold seed will give a Legendary Joker that doesn't yet have a Gold Sticker, which will help with the Completionist++ achievement.None

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Plasma Deck > Synergies
documents.text:
You want to aim for the highest raw number boosts to Chips and Mult. Since Chips start off at a higher number, most Jokers and Consumables boost Chips with a larger raw number than Mult (e.g. Bonus Card's +30 Chips vs Mult Card's +4 Mult). This is roughly balanced on other decks, but on the Plasma Deck, Chips and Mult equally contribute to the hand score, so using cards with large +Chips will result in a much higher score.

2,4,6,8,10 with Even Steven = 10 Chips and 10 Mult
A,3,5,7,9 with Odd Todd = 77 Chips and 77 Mult

In a normal deck, focusing on only leads to a non-optimal distribution, which is fixed with the Plasma Deck and can result in much higher final scores with identical builds and the same hand.

Normal Deck Scoring: 100 × 10,000 = 1,000,000
Plasma Deck Scoring: 5,050 × 5,050 = 25,502,500

Chip boosters:

any Jokers that add large +Chips
Bonus Card enhancement (+30 Chips)
Foil edition (+50 Chips)
Red seal will trigger the card twice, so you get twice the Chips
higher rank cards (Ace card's +11 Chips vs Two card's +2 Chips)

However in later Antes, Chips only carry so far since they can only be additive in the base game (i.e. there are no XChips jokers in the base game). On the other hand, Mult can be multiplicative. While XMult is slow early on, with a high enough base Mult, this boost can be much greater than +Chips in the late game. In this example, one would need +4,000 Chips to match the power of adding a Polychrome:

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Guide: Deck Manipulation
documents.text: While starting with a standard 52-card deck (for most Decks), in Balatro, there are many ways to change the components of the deck. Along with getting strong Jokers, leveling up hands by Planet Cards, Deck Manipulation is also an important way to get higher scores, and catching up with the game, which is often neglected by new players. It is of more importance with higher Stakes, Painted Deck, and many Challenges, due to the scarcity of effects from Jokers. Also, Deck Manipulation is necessary for many play styles (for example, Red Seal Steel Kings) to get extremely high scores.

question: How did Cities: Skylines II's monthly review volume evolve over its first year?
key_points: Volume peaked at launch (21.7k reviews Oct 2023, 10.1k Nov) and fell to ~1-2k/month by early 2024 and under 1k/month by Aug-Oct 2024
Positive share also fell from ~53-62% to a low of ~26% in Mar 2024 before partially recovering (~43-57%)
answer:
- Cities: Skylines II's monthly review volume decreased significantly over its first year, from an average of 2,044.3 reviews per month in the first half to 1,057.2 reviews per month in the second half, with a p-value indicating this change is statistically significant [T1].
- The positive review share trend was relatively flat over the year, with a slight increase of 0.0398 per year, but this change is not statistically significant (p-value = 0.7388) [T1].
- A notable shift in positive review share occurred in July 2024, with a significant increase from 0.3748 before to 0.4823 after, with a p-value indicating this change is statistically significant (p-value < 0.0001) [T1].

question: Over the last 12 months of data, are Hades II or Balatro reviewed more positively, and which is trending better?
key_points: Balatro is reviewed more positively (~96.8% vs ~93.1% for Hades II)
Both flat; Hades II shows a small significant shift down around Sep 2024 (93.4% -> 89.9%), so Balatro is trending better/steadier

  - Balatro: Positive share = 96.81% (n = 36,279) [T3]

  - Balatro: Trend direction = flat, positive share change per year = -0.0045 (p = 0.6301) [T3]
  - Neither game shows a statistically significant trend change over the last 12 months (p > 0.05 for both).

**Conclusion:**
Balatro is reviewed more positively than Hades II over the last 12 months, and neither game shows a significant trend change in positive reviews.

documents.label: Call of Duty® · review · 2023-11-14 · recommended · 1222 h played
documents.text: I'd like to preface this by saying I've spent almost 1k hours on MW2 and MW3, primarily but not limited to the DMZ arena. I feel like I've gotten enough value from the title to warrant the price point or even occasional DLC from their storefront, now I would wait and catch them on sale if that's a viable option on your end. My review will be mainly based on my experience with MW3 but I will be drawing from experience across both titles since they're essentially the same game.Complaints:- MW3 Campaign does feel like an afterthought- Not fond of the CoD HQ at all, too many reboots just to get to the game mode one wants to play.Praises:- Zombies is incredible, best iteration I've played since the mode's inception.- Open world campaign missions were a fun idea. Expected something more akin to DMZ with story missions myself though.- Movement feels like you've lost 30 lbs and rediscovered you're nimble on your feet again.Noteable:- Gunsmith unlocks are both convenient and aggravating at the same time. I miss the MW2 process of leveling gun A to unlock attachment C on all your guns. This new process of doing daily challenges to unlock specific gear helps unlock some of what you want quicker but elongates the process overall.I'd say overlook the hate and make an opinion yourself.

question: What did Cities: Skylines II patch 1.1.0f1 include?
key_points: The Editor and mod support (Modding Wavelet), plus performance improvements and bug fixes
Released alongside paid content: Beach Properties asset pack and Deluxe Relax Station
answer:
Cities: Skylines II patch 1.1.0f1, released on 2024-03-25, included several updates and improvements:

- **Performance and Bug Fixes**: Addressed various performance issues and bugs, such as fixing notifications, water/sewage capacity notifications, tornado event disappearance, and issues with some states getting stuck with almost all tools [1]. It also included fixes for crashes and issues related to controllers and menu music volume [1].

- **Modding and Editor Support**: Added support for code modding, modding toolchain installation, and an editor for map creation [6]. This includes importing/exporting height maps, resource maps, and defining map details like name and theme [6].

- **New Content**: Introduced paid content such as Beach Properties and Deluxe Relax Radio Station, which includes new zoning, buildings, trees, and songs [6].

- **UI and Gameplay Enhancements**: Improved the visibility of guidelines on snow, default cursor visibility, and added new features like the Land Value System and notifications for high rent [1].

- **General Fixes**: Fixed crashes related to building connections, loading saves, and placing creatures, among others [3].

These updates aim to enhance the gameplay experience, improve performance, and support the modding community.

documents.label: Cities: Skylines II · patch_note · 2023-10-26 · Patch Notes for 1.0.11f1
documents.text:
Hi everyone.

Today we have the first of several patches to improve performance in Cities: Skylines II. While this does not address all issues we are aware of, we wanted to get you these improvements as soon as possible. Unfortunately, this patch is only available on Steam today. We're doing our very best to make it available on Microsoft Store as soon as possible.

This patch includes the following improvements and fixes:

- Changed LOD to be independent of rendering resolution to get more consistent performance with high resolutions
- Minor optimization with fog
- Depth of field optimizations and tweaks
- Global illumination tweaks
- Optimized stutters when buildings spawn/level up
- Optimized various stutters across all systems
- Fixed crash after upgrading wind turbine
- Fixed crash when car crashes into still hidden car with trailer
- Fixed crash with mesh loading (that happens with low settings mostly)

Please make sure to report any crashes or bugs on our support forum here: https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/forums/cities-skylines-2-bug-reports.1162/

Our team is working hard on getting the next round of fixes and improvements out as soon as possible. Thank you for your patience!

question: How did Cities: Skylines II's monthly review volume evolve over its first year?
key_points: Volume peaked at launch (21.7k reviews Oct 2023, 10.1k Nov) and fell to ~1-2k/month by early 2024 and under 1k/month by Aug-Oct 2024
Positive share also fell from ~53-62% to a low of ~26% in Mar 2024 before partially recovering (~43-57%)
answer:
- Cities: Skylines II's monthly review volume decreased significantly over its first year, from an average of 2,044.3 reviews per month in the first half to 1,057.2 reviews per month in the second half [T1].
- The trend in positive review share was flat over the year, with a positive share change per year of 0.0398, and a p-value of 0.7388, indicating no statistically significant change [T1].
- A notable shift occurred in July 2024, where the positive review share increased from 37.48% before to 48.23% after, with a highly significant p-value of 1.0053e-40 [T1].

question: What did Cities: Skylines II patch 1.1.0f1 include?
key_points: The Editor and mod support (Modding Wavelet), plus performance improvements and bug fixes
Released alongside paid content: Beach Properties asset pack and Deluxe Relax Station
answer:
Cities: Skylines II patch 1.1.0f1 included several features and improvements:

- **Paid Content**: Introduced new paid content such as Beach Properties and Deluxe Relax Radio Station.
- **Editor and Modding Support**: Added code modding support, modding toolchain installation and status, and an Editor with support for map creation, including import/export height map, resource map, and map details definition.
- **Performance Improvements**: Optimized various systems to reduce frame-time spikes and improve overall simulation performance, as well as UI rendering and building placement performance.
- **General Fixes and Improvements**: Addressed various bugs and issues, such as conflicts in key bindings, tutorial improvements, and fixes for building upgrades’ bonuses display and transportation line issues.

The patch also included bug fixes for issues like the UI disappearing after clicking on Line Details of CO Vehicles and crashes after certain actions. [T1]

Hello everyone!

･ About the Major Update

A major update will be released in December!

documents.text:
▼Base Related
・The building system has been reworked and improved! Basic construction is now much more intuitive and smooth!
・Pillars have been added. The days of accidentally demolishing a supporting wall and the entire 2nd flood collapsing are over!
・Axis alignment function added
・Defensive walls can now be connected
・It is now possible to connect from the roof, walls, stairs, and pillars to the foundation (previously, connections could only be started from the foundation)
・New building material "Glass" has been added. Keep an eye on your cute Pals from inside with glass walls!
・The maximum base level has been increased to 25, and the number of bases allowed has been increased from 3 to 4 at level 25
・You can now change the maximum amount of guild bases from the game options
※Note: Too many bases may lead to performance issues
・You can now change the maximum amount of base Pals from the game options
※Note: Too many Pals at one base may lead to performance issues
・Implemented a private lock function for chests. Your friends won't be able to steal your metal anymore!
・It is now possible to permanently assign a Pal to a specific facility from the Monitoring Stand
・Cakes will now be transported to chests as a priority
・Readjusted the work priority order for Pals
・Changes to defense facility specifications. Work pals will use them automatically even if they are not assigned to a specific facility
・Measures and mitigation for base pals getting stuck when a route cannot be taken

question: Who finances and runs Bancho Sushi in Dave the Diver?
key_points: Financed by Cobra and run by chef Bancho; Dave supplies fish and helps in the dining area
answer:
- Cobra finances and builds Bancho Sushi, then runs it through business deals and management.
- Bancho is the head chef responsible for preparing the restaurant's dishes.
- Dave sources ingredients for the restaurant using his scuba diving skills.
- Yoshie hires new staff members like Kyoko to work at Bancho Sushi.

Cited: [2], [3], [4]

documents.label: DAVE THE DIVER · wiki · undated · Bancho the Chef > Official description
documents.text:
Bancho the Chef is a cooking simulation + adventure game that follows Bancho from Dave the Diver during his younger days on the road to becoming a sushi master. Travel through cities across Asia and experience the joy of cooking firsthand as you follow Bancho’s journey and learn unique local cuisines!

Hands-on from cooking to serving
In each area, you’ll find master chefs. Work in their restaurants and cook to serve the customers rushing in. Plan the order of cooking carefully to serve all dish in time.

Help locals with their troubles
Every region is filled with locals with unique stories. Help solve their problems and build your reputation to attract more customers.

Gather ingredients through mini-games
Collect new ingredients in each region through a variety of mini-games and events. The ingredients you gather open up opportunities to create new dishes.

documents.label: DAVE THE DIVER · wiki · undated · Bancho > Gameplay
documents.text: Bancho is the chef of Bancho Sushi, a restaurant built by Cobra. Alongside Dave and Yoshie, the four run the business, with Dave responsible for catching the fish, Bancho for preparing the restaurant's dishes, Yoshie for hiring new Staff and Cobra managing the business and issues that arise.

documents.label: DAVE THE DIVER · wiki · undated · Dave > Appearances
documents.text:
The first appearance of the protagonist is in the first cutscene while starting a new game. Dave is sunbathing on a beach as he gets a call from his acquaintance Cobra, inviting Dave for sushi and told to hurry. Dave, a big fan of food, immediately ends his vacation and flies over to the Blue Hole. Only to find out that he is supposed to be the one to source the ingredients himself, taking more and more responsibilities to run Cobra's investments in the area.

Over time Dave not only has to help in the sourcing of ingredients but also with managing the busy night time service at Bancho Sushi. This become a re-occurring issue as Cobra has hired out his services as a diver to multiple characters including Bancho the head chef of Bancho Sushi, Dr. Bacon, the local archeologist researching Sea People, and Udo, a reporter for the Weekly Fish magazine without his knowledge or consent.

documents.label: DAVE THE DIVER · wiki · undated · Cobra > Gameplay
documents.text:
Cobra is introduced at the very beginning of the game, when he calls up Dave with the promise of sushi. On arrival, he reveals his full plan to Dave: if Dave uses his scuba diving skills to gather fish from the Blue Hole, they can then make money via Bancho Sushi, a restaurant Cobra had built that's run by Bancho, a chef and Cobra's good friend.

Cobra acts as the main way of learning the game's mechanics early on. Later, his shop is unlocked, where he sells three random items (some unique to his shop) a day and will buy most non-Fish items off Dave.

Throughout the game, it is shown that Cobra is always looking for a way to make money and that he has no issue using questionable methods to achieve these goals. As a part of his ongoing money-making schemes, he has made several deals with characters including Doctor Bacon, Duff and Udo to hire out Dave's services as a diver, having already signed working contracts without Dave's permission or knowledge.

question: How did Cities: Skylines II's monthly review volume evolve over its first year?
key_points: Volume peaked at launch (21.7k reviews Oct 2023, 10.1k Nov) and fell to ~1-2k/month by early 2024 and under 1k/month by Aug-Oct 2024
Positive share also fell from ~53-62% to a low of ~26% in Mar 2024 before partially recovering (~43-57%)
answer:
- The monthly review volume for Cities: Skylines II was higher in the first half of its first year compared to the second half [T1].
- Average monthly reviews in the first half (December 2023 to May 2024): 2,044.3 [T1].

documents.text: I'd like to preface this by saying I've spent almost 1k hours on MW2 and MW3, primarily but not limited to the DMZ arena. I feel like I've gotten enough value from the title to warrant the price point or even occasional DLC from their storefront, now I would wait and catch them on sale if that's a viable option on your end. My review will be mainly based on my experience with MW3 but I will be drawing from experience across both titles since they're essentially the same game.Complaints:- MW3 Campaign does feel like an afterthought- Not fond of the CoD HQ at all, too many reboots just to get to the game mode one wants to play.Praises:- Zombies is incredible, best iteration I've played since the mode's inception.- Open world campaign missions were a fun idea. Expected something more akin to DMZ with story missions myself though.- Movement feels like you've lost 30 lbs and rediscovered you're nimble on your feet again.Noteable:- Gunsmith unlocks are both convenient and aggravating at the same time. I miss the MW2 process of leveling gun A to unlock attachment C on all your guns. This new process of doing daily challenges to unlock specific gear helps unlock some of what you want quicker but elongates the process overall.I'd say overlook the hate and make an opinion yourself.

documents.text: そこそこ長時間やってるので長文レビューくらいしておく。 マルチはCoD4からの古参。 PCキーマウのみ使用まず統合ランチャーになったのでレビューが色々入り乱れていてややこしいとりあえず現段階（2024/6/15）のMWIIIのレビューということにする。 ...終わっちゃったよ以下は長々と書くがまずゲームの内容以前の部分だが。 通常版定価ほぼ1万円も大概ではあるのだがその値段を払うのにゲーム内のスキンやズンパス等もそこそこの値段の二重高額課金式。 そしてSeason4を迎えた今作がその値段を相応と取れる内容かと言うとかもしれない。 だがという話だがレギュラーマルチで行うのは武器レベル上げとかウォームアップがメインだが、別にそういうのもPlunderとかで出来るしバランスその他の問題もレギュラーマルチよりはるかにマシなのでわざわざ金出してこっちを買う理由はない。 正直この発表の時点でかなり萎えていた。 PC民。 特に俺のような古参にとってSHGとは何だろう

documents.text: 整个游戏偷工减料，先不讨论这个问题该甩给谁背锅，作为一名冲着剧情和僵尸模式的玩家来说，446的价格可以去足浴店找一位好的技师放松一下自己，唯独不值得来买这款傻逼游戏。枯燥乏味的剧情让人边打边昏昏欲睡，整个游戏剧情流程甚至比吊还要短几公分。僵尸模式打来打去就那么一张地图，保险库和仓库图纸的冷却时间更是逆天，谁他妈为了你那些不值钱的水晶扳手等上72小时48小时的冷却时长？还有如同家常便饭的服务器卡崩和档案登出，和冷不丁射你几枪让你碎甲的脑残ai人机，都让人直犯恶心。真诚祝愿动视亲妈的档案登出。

documents.label: Call of Duty® · review · 2024-01-10 · not recommended · 477 h played
documents.text: 좆같아도 계속 찾게되는걸 보면 콜 오브 듀티만의 대체 불가능한 게임성과 플레이 스타일이 잘 먹힌다는걸 알려주지만,Another year, another cod 를 사람들에게 지속적으로 요구하고 보여주기 위해서는MW II , MW III 같은 상황을 다시는 보여주지 않아야 한다는걸 알았으면 좋겠습니다.MW II 는 1년 내내 악질적인 운영으로 삽질 , 심지어는 84500 ~ 124000원의 가격을 받고 1년만에 반쪽짜리 MW III로 대체.또 대체된 MW III 는 84500 ~ 136400원으로, 가격 책정이 더 높게 되었지만 절대 이 정도의 가치는 아닙니다.그 결과로 MW II , MW III 모두 부정적 평가가 대다수인걸 보고 얼마나 악수를 둔건지 체감했으면 좋겠네요.슬레지 해머의 게임 살리려는 소통과 개발 방향성이 이제는 불쌍해 보입니다.액티비전 , 인피니티 워드 등등 잘 할줄 알면서 왜 안하는걸까요?

documents.text: I have attempted to play 4 matches so far. Game has crashed every time when everything was going so good. This is trash. Coming from one of the biggest game franchises in history, this is absolutely unacceptable to sell for 70 dollars. Along with all the micro transactions, the ungodly horrendous UI, stuttering, framerate drops etc. Either wait 6 months for these greedy scumbags to attempt to fix this garbage, or take your money elsewhere to a developer that cares about releasing a good product. Sick and tired of the fact that this type of thing is becoming the norm for gaming.Update: Found out that the game doesnt like when you have an overclocked GPU, set clock speed back to normal and the game hasnt randomly crashed again since. Still dont recommend due to the price tag, many other bugs, worst UI of any COD ever, and micro transactions.

- **Trend Analysis**: Both games showed a flat trend over the last 6 months. Balatro's trend had a positive share change per year of -0.0045 with a p-value of 0.6301, also indicating no significant trend change [T3].

- **Conclusion**: Balatro was reviewed more positively than Hades II over the last 12 months, and neither game showed a significant trend change over the last 6 months.

question: How did Cities: Skylines II's monthly review volume evolve over its first year?

- The difference is statistically significant (p < 0.001). [T1]

question: How did players react to Total War: WARHAMMER III Patch 4.1?
key_points: Strongly positive reaction: positive share 40.7% before vs 75.7% after (p<0.001)
Bug and price complaints fell significantly (bugs ~23% -> ~5%, price ~35% -> ~16%)
answer:
- Players' reaction to Total War: WARHAMMER III Patch 4.1, released on 2023-11-21, showed a significant improvement in positive reviews after the patch. Before the patch (from 2023-05-01 to 2023-11-01), 40.7% of reviews were positive, while after the patch (from 2023-12-01 to 2024-06-01), this increased to 75.7% (p-value = 0.0, indicating a statistically significant difference) [T1].
- A review sentiment analysis from 2023-10-21 to 2023-12-21, split by the patch release date, showed a positive share of 31.04% before the patch and 53.25% after (p-value = 0.1457, not statistically significant) [T2], suggesting a trend towards more positive sentiment but with a small sample size.
- The patch included several features such as settlement and siege battle updates, skill point resets, and bug fixes, which likely contributed to the positive reception [2].

question: How did players react to Total War: WARHAMMER III Patch 4.1?
key_points: Strongly positive reaction: positive share 40.7% before vs 75.7% after (p<0.001)
Bug and price complaints fell significantly (bugs ~23% -> ~5%, price ~35% -> ~16%)
answer:
- Players' sentiment towards Total War: WARHAMMER III shifted significantly after Patch 4.1. Before the patch (October 21 to November 21, 2023), 31% of sampled reviews were positive. After the patch (November 22 to December 21, 2023), this increased to 53% [T2].
- The overall positive review share increased from 41% before the patch to 76% after the patch, according to the trend analysis [T1].

- Price complaints decreased slightly but not significantly after the patch (from 27% to 23%) [T2].
- Bug complaints also decreased but not significantly (from 12% to 0%) [T2].
- Gameplay complaints dropped from 4% to 0% after the patch [T2].
- No significant changes were noted in performance or story complaints [T2].

question: How does Balatro's Plasma Deck change scoring, and how do you unlock it?
key_points: Plasma Deck balances (averages) Chips and Mult before multiplying, and doubles base Blind size
Unlocked by winning a run on Blue Stake difficulty or harder
answer:
- **Scoring Change**: The Plasma Deck changes the scoring calculation by averaging the total Chips and total Mult before squaring the result, which generally results in a higher score compared to the standard method. For example, a hand with 78 Chips and 4 Mult would normally score 308, but with the Plasma Deck, it scores 1,681. [1]

- **Unlock Mechanism**: The Plasma Deck is unlocked by winning a run on the Blue Stake difficulty or higher. [4]

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Guide: naneinf > Unseeded Naneinf without Legendary Jokers > Deck
documents.text: This method requires the Plasma since this Deck squares the average of your Chip and Mult scores, enabling higher scoring.

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Plasma Deck
documents.text:
number: 14
title: Plasma Deck
limit: Balance blue Chips and red Mult when calculating score for played hand red X2 base Blind size
unlock: Win a run with any deck on the Blue Stake difficulty or harder

The Plasma Deck is one of the decks you can unlock when playing the game, by winning a run on the Blue Stake difficulty. This deck changes how a hand score is calculated and doubles the size of Blinds.

For example if you had a Level 1 flush (Q, 10, 9, 7, 6), the hand score would normally be

77 × 4 = 308

However with the Plasma deck, the total Chips and total Mult are averaged together (or balanced) before they get multiplied.

78 + 4 = 82
82 / 2 = 41
41 × 41 = 1,681

This is a significantly higher number and is offset by having Blind sizes twice as high when playing this deck. In fact, the hand score will always be higher after balancing (except in the case that its Chips and Mult are equal). The hand score is calculated as .

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Plasma Deck > Synergies > Poker Hands
documents.text:
Playing many scoring cards is very efficient in this deck, example Two Pair:

A,A,10,10 = 62 Chips and 2 Mult, which becomes 32 Chips and 32 Mult = 1,024

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Stakes
documents.text:
Balatro has 8 stakes, which add progressively ramping difficulty modifiers to each game. To unlock a stake for a deck, you must complete a run using the highest currently unlocked stake. Progression through the different stakes is unique to each starting deck, meaning that you must unlock each stake individually for each deck.

The 8 stakes, listed in the order that they are unlocked. Note that each stake applies the modifiers of all previous stakes.

StakeName EffectUnlocks Deck on win1White StakeBase difficulty None2Red StakeSmall Blind gives no reward moneyZodiac3Green StakeRequired score scales faster for each AntePainted4Black Stake 30% chance for Jokers in shops or booster packs to have an Eternal sticker (Can't be sold or destroyed)Anaglyph5Blue Stake -1 DiscardPlasma6Purple StakeRequired score scales even faster for each AnteNone7 Orange Stake30% chance for Jokers in shops or booster packs to have a Perishable sticker (Debuffed after 5 Rounds)Erratic8Gold Stake30% chance for Jokers in shops or booster packs to have a Rental sticker (Costs $3 per round, can be bought for $1)
The first Soul card in a Gold seed will give a Legendary Joker that doesn't yet have a Gold Sticker, which will help with the Completionist++ achievement.None

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Plasma Deck > Synergies
documents.text:
You want to aim for the highest raw number boosts to Chips and Mult. Since Chips start off at a higher number, most Jokers and Consumables boost Chips with a larger raw number than Mult (e.g. Bonus Card's +30 Chips vs Mult Card's +4 Mult). This is roughly balanced on other decks, but on the Plasma Deck, Chips and Mult equally contribute to the hand score, so using cards with large +Chips will result in a much higher score.

2,4,6,8,10 with Even Steven = 10 Chips and 10 Mult
A,3,5,7,9 with Odd Todd = 77 Chips and 77 Mult

In a normal deck, focusing on only leads to a non-optimal distribution, which is fixed with the Plasma Deck and can result in much higher final scores with identical builds and the same hand.

Normal Deck Scoring: 100 × 10,000 = 1,000,000
Plasma Deck Scoring: 5,050 × 5,050 = 25,502,500

Chip boosters:

any Jokers that add large +Chips
Bonus Card enhancement (+30 Chips)
Foil edition (+50 Chips)
Red seal will trigger the card twice, so you get twice the Chips
higher rank cards (Ace card's +11 Chips vs Two card's +2 Chips)

However in later Antes, Chips only carry so far since they can only be additive in the base game (i.e. there are no XChips jokers in the base game). On the other hand, Mult can be multiplicative. While XMult is slow early on, with a high enough base Mult, this boost can be much greater than +Chips in the late game. In this example, one would need +4,000 Chips to match the power of adding a Polychrome:

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Guide: Deck Manipulation
documents.text: While starting with a standard 52-card deck (for most Decks), in Balatro, there are many ways to change the components of the deck. Along with getting strong Jokers, leveling up hands by Planet Cards, Deck Manipulation is also an important way to get higher scores, and catching up with the game, which is often neglected by new players. It is of more importance with higher Stakes, Painted Deck, and many Challenges, due to the scarcity of effects from Jokers. Also, Deck Manipulation is necessary for many play styles (for example, Red Seal Steel Kings) to get extremely high scores.

question: How does Balatro's Plasma Deck change scoring, and how do you unlock it?
key_points: Plasma Deck balances (averages) Chips and Mult before multiplying, and doubles base Blind size
Unlocked by winning a run on Blue Stake difficulty or harder
answer:
- The Plasma Deck changes scoring by balancing the total Chips and total Mult before they are multiplied to calculate the hand score. For example, a hand with 78 Chips and 4 Mult would be calculated as (78 + 4) / 2 = 41, then 41 × 41 = 1,681 [1].
- To unlock the Plasma Deck, you must win a run on the Blue Stake difficulty or harder [3].
- The Plasma Deck also doubles the size of Blinds, offsetting the higher hand scores [1].

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Plasma Deck
documents.text:
number: 14
title: Plasma Deck
limit: Balance blue Chips and red Mult when calculating score for played hand red X2 base Blind size
unlock: Win a run with any deck on the Blue Stake difficulty or harder

The Plasma Deck is one of the decks you can unlock when playing the game, by winning a run on the Blue Stake difficulty. This deck changes how a hand score is calculated and doubles the size of Blinds.

For example if you had a Level 1 flush (Q, 10, 9, 7, 6), the hand score would normally be

77 × 4 = 308

However with the Plasma deck, the total Chips and total Mult are averaged together (or balanced) before they get multiplied.

78 + 4 = 82
82 / 2 = 41
41 × 41 = 1,681

This is a significantly higher number and is offset by having Blind sizes twice as high when playing this deck. In fact, the hand score will always be higher after balancing (except in the case that its Chips and Mult are equal). The hand score is calculated as .

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Plasma Deck > Synergies
documents.text:
1.5x Polychrome × 8 Mult = 12 Mult— the Polychrome effectively gives +4 Mult which balances to +2 Chips and +2 Mult
1.5x Polychrome × 8,000 Mult = 12,000 Mult—the Polychrome effectively gives +4,000 Mult which balances to +2,000 Chips and +2,000 Mult

This makes the Plasma Deck one of the best decks for Endless mode, since even though the score requirement per Ante is doubled, by focusing on the XMult, the score one achieves is almost squared from the score achieved in any other deck.

An Endless run example: 4 Polychrome Red Seal Glass 2s, Level 20 Four of a Kind, The Idol/Blueprint/Hack/Brainstorm/Perkeo, and Observatory with 115 Negative Mars cards

Chips:
Each card gives 2 Chips × 4 triggers (one from card, one from Red Seal, one from Blueprint Hack, one from Hack) = 8 Chips
The resulting Chips is 630 (base) + (8 Chips × 4 cards) = 630 + 32 = 662 Chips
Mult:
Each card gives an XMult of (2 Glass × 1.5 Polychrome × 2 Idol × 2 Brainstorm Idol)^4 retriggers = 12^4 = 20,736
The resulting Mult is 64 (base) × (20,736^4 cards) × (1.5^115 Mars cards) = 64 × 184,884,258,895,036,416 × 178,030,655,708,718,648,266 = 2.1e39 Mult

On a regular deck, the resulting score is 662 Chips × 2.1e39 Mult = 1.4e42, which is enough to beat Ante 19.

But on the Plasma Deck, the resulting score is ((662 Chips + 2.1e39 Mult) / 2)2 = (1.1e39)2 = 1.1e78, which is enough to beat Ante 24.

This means, on the Plasma Deck, this build with the current setup has a headstart of 5 Antes.

documents.text:
Balatro has 8 stakes, which add progressively ramping difficulty modifiers to each game. To unlock a stake for a deck, you must complete a run using the highest currently unlocked stake. Progression through the different stakes is unique to each starting deck, meaning that you must unlock each stake individually for each deck.

The 8 stakes, listed in the order that they are unlocked. Note that each stake applies the modifiers of all previous stakes.

documents.label: Balatro · wiki · undated · Plasma Deck > Synergies
documents.text:
You want to aim for the highest raw number boosts to Chips and Mult. Since Chips start off at a higher number, most Jokers and Consumables boost Chips with a larger raw number than Mult (e.g. Bonus Card's +30 Chips vs Mult Card's +4 Mult). This is roughly balanced on other decks, but on the Plasma Deck, Chips and Mult equally contribute to the hand score, so using cards with large +Chips will result in a much higher score.

2,4,6,8,10 with Even Steven = 10 Chips and 10 Mult
A,3,5,7,9 with Odd Todd = 77 Chips and 77 Mult

In a normal deck, focusing on only leads to a non-optimal distribution, which is fixed with the Plasma Deck and can result in much higher final scores with identical builds and the same hand.

Normal Deck Scoring: 100 × 10,000 = 1,000,000
Plasma Deck Scoring: 5,050 × 5,050 = 25,502,500

Chip boosters:

any Jokers that add large +Chips
Bonus Card enhancement (+30 Chips)
Foil edition (+50 Chips)
Red seal will trigger the card twice, so you get twice the Chips
higher rank cards (Ace card's +11 Chips vs Two card's +2 Chips)

However in later Antes, Chips only carry so far since they can only be additive in the base game (i.e. there are no XChips jokers in the base game). On the other hand, Mult can be multiplicative. While XMult is slow early on, with a high enough base Mult, this boost can be much greater than +Chips in the late game. documents.label: Balatro · patch_note · 2023-10-16 · Update 0.9.0q-DEMO
documents.text:
After lots of work and great feedback from the Balatro community - I have added a bunch of new QOL features and updated some things that should hopefully make the demo feel like a more seamless experience!

The main update is a new deck peek feature - where you have 2 ways to look at your pool of undrawn cards during the round. You also now interact with your deck by clicking it instead of going to 'Run Info'.

There is also an improved tooltip system that should give better vital context throughout the game.

Check out all changes and fixes below!

Changes:
-General performance improvements
-Can now sell cards in more situations
-Changed negative effect to be slightly hue shifted
-New run screen in main menu defaults to 'Continue' when applicable
-reworded Death to be more clear
-Bosses that debuff your entire hand and throw it away warn you when they are about to do so
-Brand new tooltip system, more information is now displayed for cards
-Renamed high scores to stats
-New top 10 stats screen for each most used Joker/Consumable/Voucher
-You now get a sticker for beating the demo with the base Stake difficulty for each Joker in the collection
-Seeded runs can no longer discover items in your collection
-Seeded runs no longer count toward your stats
-Seeded runs no longer allow you to unlock items in your collection
-View Deck button only shows on hover
-Changed Blackboard to count debuffed spades/clubs but NOT debuffed wildcards
-Changed wording on Dusk to say 'Retrigger'
-C
